Challenged.description: What a challenge answers: the nonce the server minted for this connection, kept as its one pending challenge; a second challenge replaces the first.

fields.name: nonce
fields.description: 32 bytes of the server's entropy as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, one per challenge.

Prove.description: The client's proof over the pending challenge: the key it claims, its possession of that key bound to this connection's audience and nonce, and the chain of grants ending at that key.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The key the client claims, as ed25519: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

fields.name: possession
fields.description: The possession proof in nightseam-auth/1 over the nonce and the connection binding, 128 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

fields.name: chain
fields.description: The grant envelopes, root first, each as lowercase hexadecimal; it must hold under the server's root and end at the subject.

Proved.description: What a proof answers once the context is made: the chain's effective validity, finite or unbounded.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: The earliest finite expiry along the chain, in seconds since the Unix epoch, UTC; absent when the whole chain is unbounded.
